Ordered medication online form but forgot to order blood pressure medication, so when I had my other medication delivered my blood pressure medication was missing so I rang them up and was told I didn't Ordered my mistake it can happen especially when you are a carer for someone else as well as having you're own illnesses,  I told reception that I only had 2 tablets left, I was told to ring 111 and they will issue medication for me,  I rang 111 and was told that I shouldn't of been told to ring 111 as they know that prescription cannot be issued until 18.30, 111 told me to ring st Lawrence back as they have a duty of care to me, rang st Lawrence back and told the receptionist what 111 told me and the receptionist said I will send link to your phone, I told her I'm a carer for my mum and have medication delivered by in house pharmacy as it's hard for me to go out with my own illnesses as well, she told me that my medication will be delivered,  when I clicked on link there was only 2 choices of pharmacy available to request prescription, both nowhere near me and I don't drive,  so when pharmacy rang me and said they issue medication for me 4 days supply I asked can you deliver they said no , so I had to book a taxi to collect my medication for me which cost me £13 , I actually felt like does anyone at st Lawrence actually care that I would of been without medication over the weekend.🤔
FRUSTRATING ,
moved here 1st August needed hospital follow up appointment after operation for cancer, i had in June, rang to find out if my referral had been made was told it hadn't been done and that it was the hospitals fault for not passing my details on ,& that the Dr/GP would get on to it, rang 10 days later only to be told we can't refer you ,the hospital that i had my treatment at has to do the referral  to my now local hospital, Rang the hospital only to be told your new GP has to do the referral . THIS STILL HASN'T BEEN SORTED
the lack of the right communication and the wrong information given is high ,at the end of the day we are just numbers and targets .
